declaration_1_ret_N_evidence_source.text:
# WHAT IS READ  : `data/annotations/structs/*.json` — `methods{addr: {name}}`, used as the (class, method) -> VA index for the ret-N probe.
# WHY IT MUST BE READ: the gate needs a *binary* fact (the function-tail `ret N` immediate = true __thiscall stack-param byte count). The only route from a rendered `Cls::Method(...)` call to that fact is an address, and the address is only carried by the struct annotations' method table.
# WHY IT CANNOT BE MIGRATED: `_sig_evidence_pack.json` as the ONLY source -> 167/3524 files drift and 90.0% of the evidence table (3299 -> 335 non-None entries) disappears (direction includes silent passes); slot counts parsed from `asm/pal3/ida_structs.json` signatures -> 219/3524 files drift and the two sources disagree on 758 of 3332 callees; neither source is a superset of the other.

declaration_2_class_hierarchy_source.text:
# WHAT IS READ  : `data/annotations/structs/*.json` — `base_class` (+ `name`), used as the class-hierarchy edge set for `_is_derived_from`.
# WHY IT MUST BE READ: the OOP transform must decide whether `Derived::this` and `Base::Method` are related (legal base-class direct call that SHADOWS a virtual, byte-relevant) or unrelated. That relation exists nowhere in the rendered code.
# WHY IT CANNOT BE MIGRATED: `asm/pal3/ida_structs.json.bases` is NOT equivalent — annotations carry 179 classes with `base_class`, the export has 175 non-empty `bases`; neither is a superset; the export is missing CEffCamera / CEffTemplate / CEffTime / _Item_List_Info entirely (annotation base_class present, export `bases` empty) and there is no export-only base. Swapping changed 0/3524 files today, i.e. it is output-neutral ONLY because no live site touches those four classes — an accident of the corpus, not an equivalence proof.
